scripts.clean:next: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path'),root=fs.realpathSync(process.cwd()),target=path.resolve(root,'.next');if(path.dirname(target)!==root)throw new Error('Refusing to clean outside the web workspace');fs.rmSync(target,{recursive:true,force:true})"
scripts.typegen:next: corepack pnpm run clean:next && next typegen
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm run typegen:next && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.build:vinext: corepack pnpm run clean:dist && corepack pnpm --filter @velyq/application... build && corepack pnpm --filter @velyq/database build && vinext build && corepack pnpm run prerender
